minimum_effect_wire_sequence: MATERIALIZE_EXACT_SCENARIO_SOURCE COMPLETE response with full workspace_state
COMPILE_EXACT_SCENARIO COMPLETE response with full post-reap workspace_state

extra_in_effect_observation.required_checks: Fresh exact-generation owner state and final local source/readback/current-manifest fence remain mandatory before compilation; four wire frames do not waive these checks.
extra_in_effect_observation.source_to_wire_allocation_limit: The frozen coordination text does not prescribe an additional distinct OBSERVE_CURRENT_WORKSPACE wire exchange. Its implementation is not proven. Candidate A's BEFORE_READINESS_OR_EFFECT wording is a conditional candidate requirement, not a universal additional frame.

mutation_poststate.workspace_state_observation_challenge: Separate single-use 32-byte owner challenge encoded as 64 lowercase hex, prebound with its sequence in the spent mutation admission.
mutation_poststate.readiness: Operation-bound source evidence only. A new OBSERVE_* challenge remains mandatory before readiness or handoff, outside the newly frozen successful effect endpoint.

writer_evidence.reason: A controller executing as UID/GID65534 can potentially write both frozen01777 tmpfs roots. Every potential/open writer must be accounted by an original relation.
writer_evidence.post_materialization: Controller and its task remain. Source creation/readback descriptors cannot be assumed still open or closed absent a reviewed descriptor lifecycle. Root potential-write access remains; /work/classes and possibly source access also require exact accounting under the eventual inventory semantics.
writer_evidence.post_compilation: Compiler/group/tasks/writers must be gone after successful reap and EOF. Controller and its task remain, with potential access to both roots, classes and possibly source/class files according to actual observed modes and retained handles.
writer_evidence.one_writer_two_root_handles: Structural lower profile only. It includes the unavoidable potential access to /tmp and /work, but no frozen rule establishes that root entries cover all descendant access or that exactly two handles exhaust the truthful inventory.
writer_evidence.exact_minimum_inventory: UNRESOLVED: potential-access coverage/grouping, descriptor lifecycle, observed creation modes/umask and identity encodings have not been specified.

mode.semantic_integer_convention: UNRESOLVED: no frozen full st_mode versus permission bits convention; no frozen source/classes/class creation modes or umask.

uid_gid.mount_roots_and_manifest_entries: Actual observed metadata required. Controller-created objects should retain actual creation ownership; generic zero substitution is not evidence.

link_counts.directory_and_mount_roots: Observed positive integer; no exact count frozen.

pid_tid_parent_pid_child_pid.universal_exact_values: Not frozen by the semantic architecture-independent contract.
pid_tid_parent_pid_child_pid.candidate_A_only: Single PID1 controller/main TID1/parent0; actual compiler child PID not frozen.

namespace_cgroup_start_text.semantic_exact_encoding: Not universally frozen for all new identity fields.
namespace_cgroup_start_text.existing_observation_precedent: Readlink text from /proc/*/ns/* and raw or stripped /proc/*/cgroup text exist in historical fixed probes. They do not settle the future aggregate namespace_identity, generations, start_identity or process/group references.
namespace_cgroup_start_text.maximum_basis: ensure_ascii=true can encode each permitted one-byte ASCII control as six bytes; NUL alone is forbidden by id. This is a schema upper envelope, not an attainable kernel format or a claim that kernel identity text contains controls.

source_and_class.source_read_method: AST literal recovery only; never owner import/issuance/accessor call.
source_and_class.wire_requirement: Full source manifest and materialization readback identity; schema forbids raw source/class/capture bytes in protocol messages.
source_and_class.other_class_metadata: Path, internal_class_name=SyntheticStateBox, inspection_kind=inert_bounded_classfile_metadata and class_loaded=false are exact fixed fields. No major/minor version, constant-pool count or methods are serialized by this schema. Actual internal identity must still be checked inertly after a real future compilation; it is not measured here.
source_and_class.compiler: Exact fixed javac path/hash/eight argv/cwd/eight-variable closed environment/image plus full seven namespaces and cgroup identity; no target JVM. capture_and_reap must have successful exact flags, zero observed bytes on both child streams and exact empty SHA256.
